visualCharacteristics.purpose: Responsive 16:9 YouTube/Vimeo/MP4 player with optional poster image, heading, description and collapsible transcript

contentPattern.structure: a cell with the video link (YouTube, Vimeo or .mp4); optionally a poster picture (click to play), heading/text/CTA cells, and a transcript: a paragraph labelled 'Transcript', 'Transcription' or 'Read transcript' followed by the transcript text, either in the same cell or in the next cell, or as a single link to a /fragments/ path loaded on first open

usage: Product and campaign videos (14 pages), wellbeing exercise videos with description and transcription, a poster-image campaign video, and a dark product explainer.
reuseGuidance: Use for one video. `light` frames the video with its text; `image` signals a poster image (any authored picture is used as the poster); `dark` keeps a leading heading above the video. Use cards-feature for grids of cards that include videos.
